description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Detail of the elected new Chairman in the meetings convened - Valvettithurai U/C and Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election results and declarations of new Chairpersons for specific Local Authorities (Valvettithurai Urban Council and Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes, specifically the outcome of elections for local government positions.
